article_title: GTA 6 sales hit $3.8bn in single day - the biggest launch in history
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on vocabulary in context, evidence-based comprehension, inference, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article call GTA 6's launch historic?
options: Its estimated $3.8bn first-day sales set a record across entertainment media
It was the first video game sold on consoles
It earned less than GTA 5 in its opening week
It launched only in New Zealand
tasks.correct_answer: Its estimated $3.8bn first-day sales set a record across entertainment media
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המכירות המוערכות ביום המלא הראשון הגיעו ל־3.8 מיליארד דולר, שיא להשקה בכל תחום הבידור.

tasks.prompt: How many copies of GTA 6 were pre-sold?
options: 8.6 million
13 million
32.5 million
212 million
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חברת Take-Two מסרה שנמכרו מראש 32.5 מיליון עותקים.

tasks.prompt: What did Cloudflare data suggest about some players in New Zealand?
options: They downloaded only the PC version
Some players may have switched regions to get early access
They avoided the game because of its file size
They spent less time online than normal
tasks.correct_answer: Some players may have switched regions to get early access
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הזינוק החריג בניו זילנד לפני הזמינות במקומות אחרים רמז שחלק מהשחקנים החליפו אזור כדי לקבל גישה מוקדמת.

tasks.prompt: What does “predecessor” refer to in the article?
options: A future multiplayer expansion
A film used for comparison
The company that measures internet traffic
The earlier game GTA 5
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Predecessor הוא הדבר שקדם לאחר; כאן הכוונה ל־GTA 5, המשחק הקודם בסדרה.

tasks.prompt: Where did about three quarters of GTA 6 sales occur?
options: On PlayStation 5
On personal computers
On mobile phones
On Nintendo consoles
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Sensor Tower העריכה שכשלושה רבעים מהמכירות היו ב־PlayStation 5, והיתר ב־Xbox.

tasks.prompt: Why could multiplayer generate substantial future revenue for Rockstar?
options: It will remove all in-game purchases
It is already free on PCs
Players may spend real money on virtual property, cars and other perks over many hours
It will replace the single-player game immediately
tasks.correct_answer: Players may spend real money on virtual property, cars and other perks over many hours
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הניסיון מ־GTA 5 מצביע שמצב מרובה משתתפים מוסיף שעות משחק והכנסות מרכישות בתוך המשחק.

tasks.prompt: Compare GTA 6's launch figures with GTA 5 and the film Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין 3.8 מיליארד דולר ביום אחד ל־1.15 מיליארד בחמישה ימים של GTA 5 ול־2.5 מיליארד לאורך כל הקרנת הסרט.
expected_points: GTA 6 reached an estimated $3.8bn in its first full day.
GTA 5 had earned $1.15bn in five days during its record opening week.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day made $2.5bn during its entire cinema run.

tasks.prompt: Give three signs that the launch placed unusual pressure on internet networks.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה נתונים מן הכתבה: פי 8.6 הורדות PS5 בבריטניה, פי 14.8 בניו זילנד, פי 11.2 באוסטרליה, פי 9.3 בחוף המזרחי של ארה״ב, או שיא התעבורה של Virgin Media O2.
expected_points: UK PS5 downloads peaked at 8.6 times normal levels.
New Zealand saw a 14.8-fold spike, while Rockstar traffic reached 11.2 times normal in Australia and 9.3 times on the US East Coast.
The 212GB installation rush broke Virgin Media O2's evening traffic record.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences explaining why the article expects GTA 6 to keep earning money after its record launch.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להתייחס לפופולריות, להשקה עתידית למחשב, להרחבת מרובה המשתתפים ולרכישות בתוך המשחק, תוך הבהרה שתאריכי ההשקות טרם פורסמו.
expected_points: The game began with exceptionally high sales and a large installed audience.
A PC version has not yet been dated and could add more buyers.
A future multiplayer expansion could extend engagement for many hours.
In-game spending on property, cars and perks could provide continuing revenue, as it did for GTA 5.

tasks.prompt: Summarise GTA 6's commercial launch, network impact and long-term business potential in 5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול 3.8 מיליארד דולר, 32.5 מיליון מכירות מוקדמות, זינוקי תעבורה, עלות פיתוח מעל מיליארד דולר והכנסות עתידיות ממחשב ומרובה משתתפים.
expected_points: GTA 6 generated an estimated $3.8bn on its first full day after 32.5m pre-sales.
The launch surpassed earlier gaming and film benchmarks cited in the article.
Downloads and online-service traffic rose many times above normal in several countries.
The game may have cost more than $1bn to develop.
Future PC and multiplayer releases plus in-game purchases could extend Rockstar's revenue for years.
